item.title: Speed bumps exceed the legal maximum height limits, 25th October
item.description:
I am writing to formally report an issue regarding the three speed humps installed along Jasmin Way in Up Hatherley. These specific traffic calming features appear to exceed the legal maximum height limits and profile gradients set out under The Highways (Road Humps) Regulations 1999. Multiple standard passenger vehicles, driving well below the residential speed limit, are regularly bottoming out and sustaining underside scraping and cosmetic damage when passing over them. The vertical deflection on these three humps is severe enough to present a hazard to standard vehicles and local traffic flow. Please could the Highways team arrange for an inspector to visit Jasmin Way to physically measure the height and gradient profile of these three specific humps to ensure they comply with statutory dimensions? I look forward to your update and a reference number for this logged issue.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 8, Azalea Drive, Hatherley, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Several potholes along Kidnappers Lane on left hand side driving towards the school, overgrown bushes on other side of road, 25th October
item.description:
There are potholes all along Kidnappers Lane which are dangerous, especially when the road is already too narrow for 2 way traffic and it is a highly used thoroughfare. When coming from the school end towards Church Road, bushes are overgrown on the left opposite the nursery which are scratching and damaging cars. People drive away from the bushes to avoid them, which results in potential accidents. Road is far too narrow for 2 way traffic
